note: Non-urn `delegationId` — HCP delegation identifiers are urn:uuid (HCP 17.2).
Missing `delegationId` — an ending names the delegation it ends.
A `reason` in the request — the reason is fixed by who the caller is (HCP 17.6), never sent.
A member in the response — HCP answers 204 No Content, so the payload is the empty object.
